Team,

I'm kicking off a quick ownership checkpoint for deals flagged as "stale" in our SFDC export (attached). Finance flagged a cluster of opportunities with no activity in the last 60+ days that still show a close date inside this quarter — we need to get these into one of three states by EOD Tuesday: 1) re-commit with updated close evidence, 2) assign an owner who will drive to close (active playbook), or 3) freeze/archive (remove from commit).

Quick asks:
- Please review the attached CSV and reply with DEALS you will claim (list opp id + owner) or mark for freeze.
- If a deal requires procurement/security paperwork, call it out and copy CS/Legal in your reply.
- If you believe a close date is accurate and evidence exists, paste the supporting note (customer touch/date) inline.

I assigned a preliminary risk tag in column H — use that as a starting point, not gospel. I'm looping Samantha so Medisys is aware we'll be touching any live negotiations in their pipeline.

Attachments: SFDC_stale_deals_export_0315.csv, ownership_rollcall_notes_0315.docx

Thanks — short and sharp please.
